title: Cursor CLI agent -p finishes but leaves the files unchanged
symptoms: The final answer describes edits, but git diff is empty
A batch script over many files exits 0 and changes nothing
cause: In print mode the CLI only proposes changes unless --force (or --yolo) is passed, so non-interactive runs do not write files by default.
fix: Add --force for runs that should write, and scope what runs unprompted with permissions allow and deny lists in cli-config.json or .cursor/cli.json.
